repositories.name: job-seeker-copilot-client
repositories.responsibility: Authenticated product UI and same-origin BFF with an explicit downstream route allowlist.
repositories.ownedState: HttpOnly browser session cookies only; no application database.
repositories.contract: Angular models/generated clients plus Express /api proxy routes
repositories.noteworthy: Removes bearer tokens from browser storage, applies CSRF and provider-link boundaries, and presents explicit live/fixture/failure states.

repositories.name: authentication-service
repositories.responsibility: Account registration, credential verification, reset, refresh/logout lifecycle, RS256 access tokens and JWKS.
repositories.noteworthy: Canonicalises email identity, bounds login attempts and keeps browser tokens behind the BFF cookie boundary.

repositories.name: user-management-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Browser-facing registration, session, profile and evidence facade.
repositories.contract: Versioned browser-session and profile routes under /api/auth/**
repositories.noteworthy: Derives trusted downstream identity and maps failures to stable redacted browser responses.

repositories.name: user-profile-service
repositories.responsibility: Progressive profile, preferences, Evidence Library, immutable revisions and purpose-bound snapshots.
repositories.ownedState: Profile, canonical preferences, evidence entries/revisions and evidence snapshots.
repositories.noteworthy: Optimistic revisions, confirmation state, provenance and SHA-256 digests prevent mutable biography from becoming generation truth.

repositories.name: job-finder-gateway
repositories.responsibility: JWT-protected search, saved-job and application facade for the browser.
repositories.noteworthy: Forwards verified subject identity, preserves source provenance and exposes partial-provider status truthfully.

repositories.name: job-service
repositories.responsibility: Five-provider fan-out, canonical mapping, deduplication, detail hydration and saved immutable job snapshots.
repositories.ownedState: Saved jobs and bounded search/detail cache.
repositories.noteworthy: Keeps source references and field provenance while tolerating partial provider failure and heterogeneous identifiers.

repositories.name: job-matching-service
repositories.responsibility: Reconcile search results with existing applications and attach bounded advisory commute assessments.
repositories.noteworthy: Rejects ambiguous identity matches; deliberately does not claim semantic candidate-suitability scoring.

repositories.name: reed-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Reed search/detail authentication, mapping and provider-mode boundary.
outbound: System Data Service in fixture mode
repositories.noteworthy: Default fixture mode; bounded live requests, source links and provider attribution.

repositories.name: adzuna-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Credentialed Adzuna paging and response mapping.
outbound: System Data Service in fixture mode
repositories.noteworthy: Bounds pagination and provider failures while preserving workplace type and source provenance.

repositories.name: jsearch-gateway
repositories.responsibility: RapidAPI JSearch request authentication and mapping.
outbound: System Data Service in fixture mode
repositories.noteworthy: Separates RapidAPI credentials/DTOs and maps inconsistent dates, descriptions and job identifiers.

repositories.name: nhs-jobs-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Official NHS Jobs Self-Serve XML search and advert mapping.
repositories.noteworthy: Preserves authoritative NHS identity through search, application and reporting flows.

repositories.name: apprenticeships-gateway
repositories.responsibility: DfE Find an apprenticeship Display Advert API v2 acquisition and search.
repositories.noteworthy: Refreshes an authenticated snapshot atomically so readers never observe a partial acquisition.

repositories.name: application-tracker-service
repositories.responsibility: System of record for saved applications, lifecycle transitions, immutable events and exact document slots.
repositories.ownedState: Applications, milestone dates, event history and frozen/selected document references.
outbound: Document Store Service for independent reference verification
repositories.noteworthy: Atomic two-slot selection and applied-state freezing prevent later document changes from rewriting application history.

repositories.name: document-generation-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Durable generation, approval, upload, export, application-linking and recovery coordinator.
repositories.ownedState: Operation ledger, deadlines, checkpoints and downstream reference IDs; never document bytes.
repositories.noteworthy: Stable idempotency keys, absolute deadlines, retained-outcome reconciliation and resumable checkpoints avoid duplicate paid/model/storage effects.

repositories.name: cv-cover-letter-service
repositories.responsibility: Evidence projection, prompt construction, typed parsing, narrow repair, claim grounding and deterministic CV fallback.
repositories.ownedState: No primary DB; optional encrypted short-lived rejected-response quarantine.
repositories.noteworthy: Treats model output as untrusted and rejects specific claims without approved evidence paths.

repositories.name: llm-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Typed provider-neutral model transport, admission bounds, timeout policy, usage and cost evidence.
outbound: System Data Service in fixture mode
repositories.noteworthy: Bounded retries apply only to classified safe failures and retain stable operation identity/audit fields.

repositories.name: document-store-service
repositories.responsibility: Document families, immutable versions, lineage, file metadata/bytes, lifecycle and retention.
repositories.ownedState: Families, versions, pointers, provenance, files and tombstones; filesystem bytes locally or S3-compatible provider.
repositories.noteworthy: Uploaded bytes are bounded/scanned; archive, recovery deletion and exact immutable application references remain separate concerns.

repositories.name: document-export-service
repositories.technology: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2, Apache POI, OpenPDF
repositories.responsibility: Stateless structured CV/letter rendering to DOCX/PDF and bounded DOCX ingestion.
repositories.noteworthy: Stable export keys make replay safe; A4 hierarchy, keep-with-next and page-break behaviour were restored through real document review.

repositories.name: reporting-gateway
repositories.responsibility: JWT-protected browser facade for summary, journal and text evidence export.
repositories.noteworthy: Keeps browser identity separate from internal read-model aggregation.

repositories.name: reporting-service
repositories.responsibility: Read-only application/profile/document summaries, recent activity, indicative time and evidence export.
repositories.ownedState: No authoritative DB; bounded projection/cache only.
repositories.noteworthy: Observes owner-scoped domain truth and never mutates application or document state.

repositories.name: payment-service
repositories.responsibility: Wallet balances, append-only transactions, reservations, commit/release and reconciliation.
repositories.ownedState: Wallets, ledger entries and AI-credit reservations.
repositories.noteworthy: Operation-key uniqueness and idempotent reservation transitions protect retries from duplicate charges.

repositories.name: payment-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Wallet, pricing and checkout facade.
repositories.noteworthy: Backend fixture path is composed, while the ordinary browser checkout route deliberately fails closed.

repositories.name: stripe-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Stripe checkout/session and signed-webhook provider boundary.
outbound: System Data Service in fixture mode
repositories.noteworthy: Live-capable code exists, but no approved standard profile exposes live browser purchasing.

repositories.name: location-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Browser-facing v1 compatibility and v2 autocomplete/resolve facade.
repositories.noteworthy: The browser-facing gateway never receives Google credentials or provider DTOs.

repositories.name: location-service
repositories.responsibility: Provider-neutral autocomplete, canonical resolution and bounded commute matrix orchestration.
repositories.noteworthy: Separates persistable canonical UK locations from transient provider/session/route fields.

repositories.name: postcode-io-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Postcodes.io place/postcode lookup and canonical UK mapping.
outbound: System Data Service in fixture mode
repositories.noteworthy: Fail-closed live/fixture selection with timeout, retry, circuit and safe URI controls.

repositories.name: google-maps-gateway
repositories.responsibility: Sole Google Places/Routes credential, attribution and DTO boundary.
repositories.ownedState: Transient bounded session tokens; no provider-content database.
repositories.noteworthy: Disabled by default and enabled only through explicit profiles with attribution and retention boundaries.

repositories.name: system-data-service
repositories.responsibility: Versioned synthetic personas, provider fixtures and guarded named-state orchestration.
repositories.ownedState: Source-controlled synthetic datasets and bounded in-memory indexes.
repositories.contract: Fixture OpenAPI 1.1 plus environment lifecycle APIs
repositories.noteworthy: Strictly non-production; repeatability and zero-spend safety are explicit, as is its inability to prove live-provider/model behaviour.

repositories.name: e2e
repositories.responsibility: Authoritative browser journeys, accessibility automation, capacity workload and promotional recording.
repositories.ownedState: Disposable reports, traces, screenshots and media artifacts.
repositories.contract: Feature files, step definitions and tagged runtime profiles
repositories.noteworthy: The product-showcase video is generated from an executable 26-step journey rather than hand-staged interaction.

repositories.name: infrastructure
repositories.responsibility: Fleet catalogue, environment overlays, revision locks, bootstrap, health/mode checks, evidence tooling and central documentation.
repositories.ownedState: Compose volumes and runtime-only generated environment files.
outbound: All runtime repositories and infrastructure containers
repositories.contract: services.json, workspace-lock.json, lifecycle CLI and Compose profiles
external: optional live provider APIs through owned gateways
repositories.noteworthy: Makes the multi-repository product reproducible while keeping fixture, live and paid-provider modes explicit.

repositories.name: job-seeker-copilot-landing
repositories.responsibility: Separate public product site, double-opt-in waitlist and contact journey.
repositories.ownedState: DynamoDB subscriber/contact workflow state in the deployed landing stack.
repositories.contract: Public pages and waitlist/contact HTTP APIs
repositories.noteworthy: Operationally separate from the authenticated application and governed by independent launch gates.
